units.en: First year of the Tongzhi reign (renxu)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 1, renxu
Yiledonga.
Yurui.

units.zh: 察杭阿二月辛酉遷。增慶理藩院右侍郎。閏八月丙申慶明理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: On the xinyou day of the second month, Chahanga was transferred. Zengqing: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, Qingming: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: On the xinyou day of the second month, Chahanga was transferred. Zengqing: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, Qingming: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 倭仁正月己亥遷。文祥左都御史。閏八月丙申遷。載齡左都御史。
units.en: On the jihai day of the first month, Woren was transferred. Wenxiang: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, was transferred. Zailing: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the jihai day of the first month, Woren was transferred. Wenxiang: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month, was transferred. Zailing: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 羅惇衍七月庚子遷。李棠階左都御史。
units.en: On the gengzi day of the seventh month, Luo Dunyan was transferred. Li Tangjie: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the gengzi day of the seventh month, Luo Dunyan was transferred. Li Tangjie: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 志和十一月遷。鍾岱代。三月乙未阿克敦布左副都御史。十一月乙卯遷。丁卯鍾岱左副都御史。
units.en: In the eleventh month, Zhihe was transferred. Zhongdai served as replacement. On the yiwei day of the third month, Akedunbu: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the eleventh month, was transferred. On the dingmao day, Zhongdai: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Zhihe was transferred. Zhongdai served as replacement. On the yiwei day of the third month, Akedunbu: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the eleventh month, was transferred. On the dingmao day, Zhongdai: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 崇厚二月遷。阿克敦布三月代。十二月戊子景霖左副都御史。
units.en: In the second month, Chonghou was transferred. In the third month, Akedunbu served as replacement. On the wuzi day of the twelfth month, Jinglin: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the second month, Chonghou was transferred. In the third month, Akedunbu served as replacement. On the wuzi day of the twelfth month, Jinglin: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
Wang Fagui.

units.zh: 晏端書差。四月癸亥王茂蔭署左副都御史。
units.en: Yan Duanshu was on assignment. On the guihai day of the fourth month, Wang Maoyin served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Yan Duanshu was on assignment. On the guihai day of the fourth month, Wang Maoyin served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.en: Second year of the Tongzhi reign (guihai)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 2, guihai

units.zh: 伊勒東阿遷。正月庚午存誠理藩院尚書。
units.en: Yiledonga was transferred. On the gengwu day of the first month, Cuncheng: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: Yiledonga was transferred. On the gengwu day of the first month, Cuncheng: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
Yurui.

units.zh: 慶明遷。六月丙申額勒和布理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: Qingming was transferred. On the bingshen day of the sixth month, Elehebu: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: Qingming was transferred. On the bingshen day of the sixth month, Elehebu: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 載齡十二月戊子遷。全慶左都御史。
units.en: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month, Zailing was transferred. Quanqing: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month, Zailing was transferred. Quanqing: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 李棠階遷。二月乙酉單懋謙左都御史。
units.en: Li Tangjie was transferred. On the yiyou day of the second month, Shan Maoqian: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Li Tangjie was transferred. On the yiyou day of the second month, Shan Maoqian: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 鍾岱五月桂清署左副都御史。
units.en: Zhongdai. In the fifth month, Guiqing served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Zhongdai. In the fifth month, Guiqing served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
Jinglin.
Wang Fagui.
Yan Duanshu.

units.en: Third year of the Tongzhi reign (jiazi)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 3, jiazi
Cuncheng.
Yurui.
Elehebu.
Quanqing.

units.zh: 單懋謙七月癸亥遷。齊承彥左副都御史。
units.en: On the guihai day of the seventh month, Shan Maoqian was transferred. Qi Chengyan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the guihai day of the seventh month, Shan Maoqian was transferred. Qi Chengyan: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 鍾岱七月庚戌遷。八月十三恆恩左副都御史。
units.en: On the gengxu day of the seventh month, Zhongdai was transferred. On the thirteenth day of the eighth month, Heng'en: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the gengxu day of the seventh month, Zhongdai was transferred. On the thirteenth day of the eighth month, Heng'en: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
Jinglin.

units.zh: 王發桂正月丙寅遷。丁卯汪元方左副都御史。九月丙午賀壽慈左副都御史。
units.en: On the bingyin day of the first month, Wang Fagui was transferred. On the dingmao day, Wang Yuanfang: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the bingwu day of the ninth month, He Shouci: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the bingyin day of the first month, Wang Fagui was transferred. On the dingmao day, Wang Yuanfang: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the bingwu day of the ninth month, He Shouci: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 晏端書三月辛酉潘祖蔭左副都御史。四月賀壽慈署左副都御史。
units.en: Yan Duanshu. On the xinyou day of the third month, Pan Zuyin: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the fourth month, He Shouci served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Yan Duanshu. On the xinyou day of the third month, Pan Zuyin: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the fourth month, He Shouci served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.en: Fourth year of the Tongzhi reign (yichou)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 4, yichou
Cuncheng.
Yurui.

units.zh: 額勒和布九月戊寅遷。己卯英元理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: On the wuyin day of the ninth month, Elehebu was transferred. On the jimao day, Yingyuan: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: On the wuyin day of the ninth month, Elehebu was transferred. On the jimao day, Yingyuan: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
Quanqing.

units.zh: 齊承彥二月戊子遷。曹毓瑛左都御史。十一月壬申遷。董恂左都御史。
units.en: On the wuzi day of the second month, Qi Chengyan was transferred. Cao Yuying: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the renshen day of the eleventh month, was transferred. Dong Xun: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the wuzi day of the second month, Qi Chengyan was transferred. Cao Yuying: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the renshen day of the eleventh month, was transferred. Dong Xun: Left Censor-in-Chief.
Heng'en.

units.zh: 景霖十月甲寅遷。十二月甲辰達慶左副都御史。
units.en: On the jiayin day of the tenth month, Jinglin was transferred. On the jiachen day of the twelfth month, Daqing: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the jiayin day of the tenth month, Jinglin was transferred. On the jiachen day of the twelfth month, Daqing: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
He Shouci.
Pan Zuyin.

units.en: Fifth year of the Tongzhi reign (bingyin)
units.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 5, bingyin
Cuncheng.

units.zh: 裕瑞五月遷。丙子英元理藩院左侍郎。十二月癸丑遷。恩承補。
units.en: In the fifth month, Yurui was transferred. On the bingzi day, Yingyuan: Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the guichou day of the twelfth month, was transferred. Encheng was appointed to fill the vacancy.
units.literal: In the fifth month, Yurui was transferred. On the bingzi day, Yingyuan: Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the guichou day of the twelfth month, was transferred. Encheng was appointed to fill the vacancy.

units.zh: 英元五月丙子遷。魁齡理藩院右侍郎。十二月癸丑遷。奕慶理藩院右侍郎。
units.en: On the bingzi day of the fifth month, Yingyuan was transferred. Kuiling: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the guichou day of the twelfth month, was transferred. Yiqing: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: On the bingzi day of the fifth month, Yingyuan was transferred. Kuiling: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the guichou day of the twelfth month, was transferred. Yiqing: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 全慶十二月癸丑遷。靈桂左都御史。
units.en: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Quanqing was transferred. Linggui: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the guichou day of the twelfth month, Quanqing was transferred. Linggui: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 董恂三月丙戌遷。汪元方左都御史。
units.en: On the bingxu day of the third month, Dong Xun was transferred. Wang Yuanfang: Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the bingxu day of the third month, Dong Xun was transferred. Wang Yuanfang: Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 恆恩十一月卒。十二月繼格左副都御史。
units.en: In the eleventh month, Heng'en died. In the twelfth month, Jige: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Heng'en died. In the twelfth month, Jige: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
